notes.title: The future of Asteria
notes.content:
Hey defenders,

I've been pretty radio silent lately but after a couple months of trying to recover my hard drive unsuccessfully it's time to throw in the towel for now. I no longer have the files for Defenders of Asteria so unfortunately there will be no more updates. The game will be going free to play as soon as Steam approves it and who knows maybe one day I will come back and remaster it to become the game I dreamed up. Until that time comes I would like to thank all of you who purchased the game from the bottom of my heart. Who knows what the future holds but I hope to continue to make games for you all to enjoy.

With great sadness this is my final sign off, thank you defenders.

notes.title: The Tower of Zog has been located
notes.content:
It's been a long ride getting this expansion ready and I'm very happy to finally be able to share it with you! I'd like to thank all of you who have purchased the game, and I know its not a huge game but you will always have my utmost support and continue to receive balance updates and new content! There were a lot of issues and bugs while coding this in and I tried to make it feel more alive. Enough with my rambling now, without further ado here are the patch notes. 


[b]Tower of Zog Update:[/b]

The first map expansion is finally here! Tackle 3 new maps and a new raid map as you try to defeat the evil mage Zog. This is a free update and will can be selected from the main menu in the '[i][u]Tower of Zog[/u][/i]' tab for quickplay and '[u][i]Raid[/i][/u]' tab for the new raid.

[b]General Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added an offset to pathing for enemies in endless mode.
[*] The 'esc' key can now be used to pause the game. (Dropped the ball on that one sorry.)
[*] Amount of crystals earned for purchasing heroes and perks increased in Quickplay and Endless modes.
[*] Changed the Fast Forward from 10 to 3 so its playable (forgot to change it back from debugging oops)
[*] Camera movement changed to WASD and On Edge Cursor to not cause issues with tower list scrolling
[/list]


[b]Balance Changes:[/b]

|TOWERS|
[list]
[*] Ballista price increased by 30
[*] Ballista damage nerfed
[*] Foot Soldier shield increased
[*] Patches health increased
[*] Ice Mage Slow buffed by 5%
[*] Druid price increased by 50
[*] Cannon damage nerfed
[/list]

|ENEMIES|
[list]
[*] Decreased gold gained on enemies slain slightly
[*] Increased health scaling in Raid mode
[*] All enemy health increased slightly
[*] Boss health increased significantly
[/list]

|MAPS|
[list]
[*] Starting cash in raids reduced by 500
[*] Endless Maps now have no limit to sub wave amount or wave size
[/list]


I hope you enjoy the new update and I look forward to you feedback!

notes.title: Launch Day + Future Roadmap!
notes.content:
Greetings Defenders!

Today is the big day, Defenders of Asteria is finally releasing on Steam. While hoping for a smooth launch, I am expecting something to go wrong at anytime, so if you find anything please report it on the Steam forums or onto the [url=https://discord.gg/PAStZaYmKP]Official Discord[/url] group.

As for the future, I have no plans for any dlc or microtransactions, all new content will be releasing in free updates. I have plans for new heroes, towers, maps, raid maps, and enemies, and will be teasing all new content and conducting polls for what the community would like to see on the [url=https://discord.gg/PAStZaYmKP]Discord[/url] as well!

I thank all of you who buy the game or share it with your friends, it truly means so much to me to finally get to release my own game and I hope you all enjoy it!

notes.title: Official Release Date!
notes.content: After so long of planning and coding, I can finally reveal the official release date for my first game Defenders of Asteria! Thank you all so much for taking a look and wish listing and sharing, this is really a dream come true!
